source_text: Podemos ofrecerle un préstamo personal por $9,500, en lugar de los $14,000 solicitados. La oferta tiene una tasa porcentual anual fija del 16.4% y un plazo de reembolso de 36 meses. No se ha aceptado ni desembolsado el préstamo. Para continuar, confirme que acepta el monto y las condiciones indicadas; si no las acepta, no se abrirá el préstamo. La oferta está sujeta a la verificación final de la información proporcionada en su solicitud.
reference_translation: We can offer you a personal loan of $9,500 instead of the $14,000 you requested. The offer has a fixed annual percentage rate of 16.4% and a repayment term of 36 months. The loan has not been accepted or disbursed. To proceed, confirm that you accept the stated amount and terms; if you do not accept them, the loan will not be opened. The offer is subject to final verification of the information provided in your application.
translation_instruction: Translate the Spanish notice into clear, formal English. Preserve the amount requested, the offered terms, and the conditions for proceeding. Do not add information that is not stated in the source.

source_text: Le informamos que no podemos aprobar su solicitud de préstamo personal en este momento. La decisión se basó principalmente en que sus obligaciones mensuales declaradas son elevadas en relación con sus ingresos y en que el informe de crédito revisado muestra pagos atrasados recientes. Estos factores limitaron nuestra evaluación de su capacidad para asumir un nuevo pago mensual. No se ha aprobado ningún préstamo ni se desembolsarán fondos.
reference_translation: We are writing to inform you that we cannot approve your personal loan application at this time. The decision was based primarily on your reported monthly obligations being high in relation to your income and on the credit report reviewed showing recent late payments. These factors limited our assessment of your ability to take on a new monthly payment. No loan has been approved, and no funds will be disbursed.
translation_instruction: Translate the Spanish notice into clear, formal English. Preserve the decision, each stated reason, and the cautious tone. Do not add explanations or rights that are not present in the source.
